changelog: - **Lines run through fewer number chips, and a bend point on a node's name is refused.** When a line ran through other lines' number chips, the route map tried a detour and kept it when it crossed fewer of those chips, even if it then crossed others: a line could trade one chip for two. A detour is now kept only when it also crosses no more chips in all, and one that runs into other chips is tried once more around them. On the MMO progression Template, lines now cross chips 39 times instead of 43; on the Gacha banner zones Template, 0 instead of 2. Lines drawn for a rule's reading go round the chips the same way, and now round a chip placed beside its line where it is drawn, not where its middle would be. A Straight line is judged by the line itself, not by the box around it, so a chip near a diagonal line is no longer kept away from it. A bend point dropped on a node's name now goes back, as on a node: the line could not pass through it there.
